ia.greeting: Hi, I'm your analytics copilot. I can help you interpret the course results according to the DeLone and McLean model. Ask me anything you need.
ia.suggestion1: Which dimension presents the highest risk and why?
ia.suggestion2: Explain the dominant beta coefficient in business terms.
ia.suggestion3: What concrete actions do you recommend to improve satisfaction?
ia.suggestion4: How do I interpret Cronbach's alpha in this context?
